entities.summary: Riley Fox was a 3-year-old girl from Wilmington, Illinois, who was murdered on June 6, 2004. After Riley's father was initially accused and then cleared by DNA evidence, paroled convict Scott Eby confessed to the crime and was convicted. Eby died in prison on December 7, 2023 while serving a life sentence without parole he received for the murder.
